task.description:
Independent verification and release decision (WF-02 Step 5) for PIN-03, PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01. Do not trust the handoff chain's claims at face value -- re-derive the release recommendation from primary sources: docs/requirements.yaml's actual AC text, the design artefacts in src/design/, the actual implementation, and by re-running the batch's own test targets yourself.

Prior gates: design (Step 1b) PASS, security review (Step 2c) PASS then a rework cycle (PIN-04 AC2/AC3 sub-process pin inheritance was found unimplemented by TEST-DESIGNER, fixed by BACKEND-DEV commit 49ae102a, re-reviewed PASS by SECURITY-REVIEWER), test design validation (Step 3b) PASS, test execution (Step 4) PASS -- unit suite 1071/1071, test-integration-pin03 5/5, test-integration-pin04 5/5, test-integration-pin05 4/4, test-integration-prm01 5/5, plus overlap checks on pin01/pin02/ee09 all clean, zero regressions.

MAKE A REAL JUDGMENT CALL on RELEASED vs TESTED-with-known-gap, following the precedent this exact stage has already established twice: WF02-batch-3-20260811 (PAR-02/PAR-03 held at TESTED for a genuine implementation gap found by RELEASE-VALIDATOR's own independent reading) and WF02-batch-4-20260811 (PIN-01 held at TESTED for AC1/AC2 blocked on the SAME service_catalog/PLC-01 infrastructure gap this batch's PIN-03 AC3 also hits -- read docs/status/release-stage16-WF02-batch-4-20260811.yaml for the exact reasoning and provenance framing used there, since PIN-03 AC3 is materially the same situation: a deliberate, validated, disclosed scope-phasing decision (not a late discovery or quality escape) tracked under the SAME issue, ISS-0672/GH-306).

Specifically evaluate PIN-03: 4 of 5 AC bullets (AC1, AC2, AC4, AC5) are fully implemented and tested; AC3 (pinned catalog entry set to DEPRECATED after instance start -> execution proceeds on pinned version) has ZERO implementation because service_catalog has no version/status column -- there is no DEPRECATED state to construct. This was disclosed at every gate (CODE-DESIGNER Step 1 PARTIAL, CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR Step 1b PASS with explicit acknowledgment, TEST-DESIGNER's test spec documenting the gap and testing a scoped structural substitute instead). Decide: does this one unmet AC (out of 5, on a MUST requirement) hold PIN-03 at TESTED rather than RELEASED, matching the batch-3/batch-4 precedent exactly (a requirement with N of M ACs met is held at TESTED, not RELEASED, regardless of how early/deliberately the gap was identified)? Or does the structural substitute the design specified and TEST-DESIGNER implemented actually satisfy AC3's SPIRIT even if not its literal letter, justifying RELEASED? Read PIN-03 AC3's exact wording and the scoped substitute test yourself before deciding -- this is exactly the kind of judgment call RELEASE-VALIDATOR exists to make, do not default to either answer without reading the primary sources.

PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01 have no known scope gaps -- verify this yourself (re-read their AC text, confirm every bullet has a passing test) before recommending RELEASED for them.

Also independently verify: (1) re-run at least test-integration-pin03/pin04/pin05/prm01 yourself, do not trust the reported counts; (2) confirm the ISS-0688/GH-745 ADHOC fix (dead bpm_effective_tenant_id() calls) that landed mid-run is genuinely resolved and GitHub issue #745 is closed; (3) check whether NFR benchmarks apply to this batch's own surface (per batch-3's precedent of explicitly checking this rather than silently skipping it) -- PIN-03/04/05/PRM-01 add new API routes and DB queries; check tests/bench/bench.zig for any applicable benchmark target.

CRITICAL ENVIRONMENT NOTE: this shell's process environment may carry a stale BPM_TEST_DB_URL from a different workspace. Before any build/test command, run `unset BPM_TEST_DB_URL BPM_DB_URL BPM_BENCH_DB_URL` then explicitly export .env's real values (BPM_TEST_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5434/bpm_test, BPM_DB_URL=postgres://bpm:bpm@localhost:5442/bpm_dev).
acceptance_criteria: Explicit RELEASED vs TESTED decision per requirement with stated reasoning
PIN-03's AC3 gap evaluated against the batch-3/batch-4 precedent with a real judgment call, not a default
Release decision document written to docs/status/
NFR/benchmark applicability explicitly checked, not silently skipped

result.summary: Independent verification complete for PIN-03/PIN-04/PIN-05/PRM-01 (Stage 16 batch 5). PIN-04, PIN-05, PRM-01 RELEASED in full (all ACs independently re-verified with real, non-vacuous, passing tests -- 5/5, 4/4, 5/5 respectively, re-run live). PIN-03 held at TESTED (PARTIAL) -- AC1/AC2/AC4/AC5 met (5/5 including scoped substitute re-run live), AC3 (pinned catalog entry set to DEPRECATED -> execution proceeds on pinned version) has zero implementation because service_catalog has no version/status column (ISS-0672/GH-306, the SAME open issue that held PIN-01 AC1/AC2 at TESTED in the immediately preceding batch). Read AC3's exact wording and TC-PIN-03-05's own inline scope-note: the scoped substitute is mechanically identical to the AC2 test (re-checks resolved_id equality) and never drives node execution through any DEPRECATED-equivalent state, so it does not reach AC3's actual behavioral claim. Applying the same precedent as batch-3 (PAR-02/PAR-03) and batch-4 (PIN-01): a MUST requirement with any unmet AC bullet is held at TESTED, not RELEASED, regardless of how early or deliberately the gap was disclosed. Independently re-ran all 4 batch-specific integration targets (pin03 5/5, pin04 5/5, pin05 4/4, prm01 5/5) plus overlap regression checks (pin01 9/9, pin02 5/5, ee09 5/5) plus the full unit suite (1071/1071 pass, 0 fail, 64 pre-existing skips) plus zig build test-env-verify (10/10 HEALTHY) -- all counts matched the TEST-RUNNER report exactly, zero regressions found. Confirmed ISS-0688/GH-745 (dropped bpm_effective_tenant_id() regression) is genuinely resolved: GitHub issue #745 is CLOSED, and grep of src/ confirms zero live executable calls remain (all matches are comments/design-doc prose). Checked NFR/benchmark applicability explicitly rather than skipping it: this batch adds 3 new HTTP routes (GET pins, POST rebind-pins, POST promotions) making NFR-01 platform-applicable, but tests/bench/bench.zig has no benchmark target for any of them -- ran zig build bench live for completeness (all 5 existing targets pass by wide margins) but explicitly recorded this as not evidence for the new routes' own latency. Filed one new incidental MINOR finding: ISS-0689/GH-748, a stale doc-comment in pin04_pin_resolution_replay_subprocess_test.zig that still describes the pre-REWORK-1 unimplemented state even though the fix (commit 49ae102a) is confirmed live-passing; added to the global queue.

issues.description: ISS-0672/GH-306 (OPEN): PIN-03 AC3 has zero implementation because service_catalog lacks a version/status column -- same root cause already blocking PIN-01 AC1/AC2 from batch-4. Held PIN-03 at TESTED, not RELEASED.

ISS-0689/GH-748 (OPEN, filed this session): stale doc-comment in tests/integration/pin04_pin_resolution_replay_subprocess_test.zig still describes the pre-fix unimplemented AC2/AC3 state; does not affect PIN-04 release marking.
